pool.arabic: الوطن العربي فيه ثنين وعشرين دولة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: الوَطَن العَرَبي فيه ثْنين وعِشرين دَولة.
pool.english: The Arab world has twenty-two countries.
pool.transliteration: il-watan il-3arabi fee thneen w-3ishreen dawla.

pool.arabic: الأفلام المصرية مشهورة بكل الدول العربية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: الأفلام المَصرية مَشهورة بكِل الدُّوَل العَرَبية.
pool.english: Egyptian films are famous in all Arab countries.
pool.transliteration: il-aflaam il-masriyya mash-hoora b-kil id-duwal il-3arabiyya.

pool.english: Levantine food is popular in the Gulf.

pool.arabic: اللهجة الكويتية تشبه لهجة جنوب العراق.
pool.arabicTashkeel: اللَّهجة الكُوَيتية تِشبَه لَهجة جَنوب العِراق.
pool.english: Kuwaiti dialect resembles southern Iraqi.
pool.transliteration: il-lahja il-kuwaytiyya tishbah lahjat janoob il-3iraag.

pool.arabic: المغرب بعيد، بالطرف الثاني من الوطن العربي.
pool.arabicTashkeel: المَغرِب بَعيد، بالطَّرَف الثّاني مِن الوَطَن العَرَبي.
pool.english: Morocco is far, at the other end of the Arab world.
pool.transliteration: il-maghrib ba3eed, bit-taraf ith-thaani min il-watan il-3arabi.

pool.english: Every country has its own dialect.

pool.arabic: التقاليد العربية تشبه بعضها بوايد أشيا.
pool.arabicTashkeel: التَّقاليد العَرَبية تِشبَه بَعَضها بوايد أشيا.
pool.english: Arab traditions are similar in many things.
pool.transliteration: it-tagaaleed il-3arabiyya tishbah ba3adha b-waayid ashya.

pool.english: The kandura is traditional dress in the Gulf.
Moroccan cuisine is famous for couscous.
The Egyptian dialect is different from the Gulf one.

I'd love to visit Egypt and see the pyramids.
Damascus is the heart of the Levant.
Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.
Moroccan Darija is hard for Gulf people.
Respecting traditions is important.

pool.arabic: اللبس التقليدي حق الحريم بالخليج العباية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: اللِّبس التَّقليدي حَق الحَريم بالخَليج العَباية.
pool.english: Women's traditional dress in the Gulf is the abaya.

pool.arabic: المطبخ الخليجي فيه أكلات عيش وايد.
pool.arabicTashkeel: المَطبَخ الخَليجي فيه أكلات عيش وايد.
pool.english: Gulf cuisine has many rice dishes.
Kuwait resembles Basra in many things.
Each region has different customs.
Shared holidays like the two Eids.
Saudi Arabia and Oman are neighbouring countries.
Language is part of identity.
Cultural diversity in the Arab world.
Egyptian is the most understood dialect.
The Levant is known for its sweets.
Iraqi masgouf is famous.
Mint tea is popular in Morocco.
I understand the Levantine dialect.
Old traditions are disappearing.
The Omani traditional dress has a cap called kuma.
Every cuisine has its secret.
Gulf music resembles Iraqi music.
Different but close.
A shared history of thousands of years.
Iran is a neighbouring country across the sea.
Emirati identity is proud of its heritage.
Diversity of food, music and dress.

pool.arabic: من الخليج لين المحيط: الوطن العربي.
pool.arabicTashkeel: مِن الخَليج لين المُحيط: الوَطَن العَرَبي.
pool.english: From the Gulf to the ocean: the Arab world.
pool.transliteration: min il-khaleej leen il-mu7eet: il-watan il-3arabi.

pool.english: I studied in Egypt for two years.
Levantine and Gulf traditions.
Morocco is different from the east.
He speaks with a Kuwaiti dialect.
Wearing traditional dress on holidays.
Lebanese cuisine is light.
His accent resembles Bahraini.
Shared values.
Neighbouring cities.
National identity.
Diversity is beautiful.

sentences.arabic: الوطن العربي يمتد من الخليج لين المحيط الأطلسي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الوَطَن العَرَبي يِمتَد مِن الخَليج لين المُحيط الأطلَسي.
sentences.english: The Arab world stretches from the Gulf to the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.transliteration: il-watan il-3arabi yimtadd min il-khaleej leen il-mu7eet il-atlasi.

sentences.english: We share the language, many traditions and the two Eids.

sentences.arabic: بس كل دولة لها لهجتها ومطبخها ولبسها التقليدي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَس كِل دَولة لها لَهجتها ومَطبَخها ولِبسها التَّقليدي.
sentences.english: But every country has its own dialect, cuisine and traditional dress.
sentences.transliteration: bas kil dawla laha lahjatha w-matbakhha w-libsha it-tagleedi.

sentences.arabic: لهجتنا قريبة من العراقية، وأكل الشام بكل مكان بالخليج.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: لَهجتنا قَريبة مِن العِراقية، وأكل الشّام بكِل مَكان بالخَليج.
sentences.english: Our dialect is close to Iraqi, and Levantine food is everywhere in the Gulf.
sentences.transliteration: lahjatna gareeba min il-3iraagiyya, w-akl ish-shaam b-kil makaan bil-khaleej.

sentences.arabic: الدارجة المغربية مختلفة وايد، بس المصري مفهوم بكل مكان بفضل الأفلام.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الدّارجة المَغرِبية مُختَلفة وايد، بَس المَصري مَفهوم بكِل مَكان بفَضل الأفلام.
sentences.english: Moroccan Darija is very different, but Egyptian is understood everywhere thanks to the films.
sentences.transliteration: id-daarja il-maghribiyya mukhtalfa waayid, bas il-masri mafhoom b-kil makaan b-fadhl il-aflaam.

sentences.english: This diversity is part of our identity.

sentences.arabic: دول الخليج تتشارك وايد: اللبس، الأكل والضيافة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: دُوَل الخَليج تِتشارَك وايد: اللِّبس، الأكل والضِّيافة.
sentences.english: The Gulf countries share a lot: the dress, the food and the hospitality.
sentences.transliteration: duwal il-khaleej titshaarak waayid: il-libs, il-akl w-idh-dhiyaafa.

sentences.arabic: بالكويت اللهجة تشبه جنوب العراق، وبعمان مختلفة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالكُوَيت اللَّهجة تِشبَه جَنوب العِراق، وبعُمان مُختَلفة.
sentences.english: In Kuwait, the dialect resembles southern Iraq; in Oman, it is different.
sentences.transliteration: bil-kuwayt il-lahja tishbah janoob il-3iraag, w-b-3umaan mukhtalfa.

sentences.english: That's why the Gulf is a meeting point of cultures.

scenario.situation: At an international food festival in Dubai, the student chats with an Emirati visitor about the different Arab cuisines and cultures on display.
scenario.otherRole: The well-travelled Emirati, who has visited many Arab countries.
scenario.goalEnglish: Compare Arab countries' dialects, food and traditional dress, say what is shared and what is different, and talk about identity and diversity.
